title: Jerk Pork
description: Jerk Pork is a dish from Jamaica featuring pork shoulder, jerk marinade, thyme, garlic. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 160 minutes.
Roast the already seasoned food in a preheated oven until tender and safely cooked, using a thermometer for meat or poultry.
Grill the marinated portions from the preceding steps, turning to cook evenly and checking the safe internal temperature.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
